runs.command: mpirun -np {1,4} ./dsmti < DATA/dsm_model at 1 to 4 frequencies with GFORTRAN_UNBUFFERED_ALL=y and timestamps; then with --mca btl self,vader, with --mca btl_tcp_if_include lo, with --stdin 0
pitfalls: OpenMPI 4.1.6 probes every interface (docker bridges, veth pairs) before the first message; --mca btl self,vader removes 150 s per launch; not stdin forwarding (the same with --stdin 0 and with each rank reading the file)
runs.reproduced: n/a: 1 rank reaches the first frequency in 0.75 s; 4 ranks take 143 to 178 s before the first frequency with OpenMPI's default transports and 0.4 s with the on-node ones

pitfalls.symptom: 173 .o files, .mod files and the executables dsmti and spectotime are committed; git restores no mtimes, so make relinks the stale objects (or fails: 'relocation R_X86_64_32S against ... can not be used when making a PIE object') and a changed FFLAGS has no effect
pitfalls.workaround: rm -f *.o *.mod dsmti spectotime before every make

pitfalls.symptom: DSM_FreqToTimeSac fails to compile with gfortran 13 when FFLAGS is overridden wholesale: sacconv.f passes COMPLEX(8) arrays to REAL(8) dummies
pitfalls.workaround: keep the Makefile's -fallow-argument-mismatch -std=legacy and vary only the optimisation level

pitfalls.symptom: dsmti stops with 'error saving GREENS' when any of OUTPUT_FILES/{disp_solid,velo_solid,disp_fluid,stress,pressure,potential,coef_cAnddcdr} is missing (savespec.f opens with status='unknown' and does not mkdir)
pitfalls.workaround: create all eight OUTPUT_FILES subdirectories before the run

pitfalls.symptom: spectotime prints 'Job completed!' and exits 0 having written nothing when the SAC output directory named in Par_file_freq2sac does not exist
pitfalls.workaround: mkdir the SAC directory first; check the file count after the run

pitfalls.symptom: run_freq_to_time_sac.sh names stations dist%.2f: two receivers less than 0.01 degrees apart get the same SAC filename and spectotime overwrites the first (the ULVZ deck's receivers are 0.002 degrees apart: 3 files for 2 receivers)
pitfalls.workaround: write station_list with five decimals of distance

pitfalls.symptom: OpenMPI 4.1.6 spends 143 to 178 s before dsmti's first frequency on a host with docker bridge and veth interfaces (TCP transport probing every interface before the first message); 1 rank is unaffected (0.75 s)
pitfalls.workaround: mpirun --mca btl self,vader (0.4 s); not a stdin issue

pitfalls.symptom: the first packager measured 851 s in the container against 314 s natively for the same 4-rank run; the 150 s MPI start-up plus 4 ranks under a 4-cpu cgroup quota with the default core binding are the likely causes
pitfalls.workaround: on-node transports and --bind-to none; measure in the selfcheck

pitfalls.symptom: gfortran buffers stdout when it is a pipe: per-frequency progress lines arrive only at exit
pitfalls.workaround: GFORTRAN_UNBUFFERED_ALL=y for timing; file mtimes of OUTPUT_FILES/disp_solid/freq_* give completion times

pitfalls.symptom: spectotime aborts at exit (munmap_chunk(): invalid pointer, SIGABRT) when the frequency count is not a power of two (24 and 6 measured; 4, 8, 16, 32 run): its FFT length is 64 x n_frequency and the transform assumes a power of two
pitfalls.workaround: keep n_frequency a power of two

pitfalls.symptom: dist_solid_list and dist_fluid_list must agree entry by entry (param.f stops when they differ by more than 1e-10 rad), even when no fluid receiver exists
pitfalls.workaround: perturb or edit both tables identically

pitfalls.symptom: each rank holds about 1.9 GB of static arrays sized for max_ndep x max_ntheta = 9e6 stations (maxngrid_r 140000, maxlmax 40000), touched during the first frequency: RSS 36 MB at start, 1966 MB by the second frequency
pitfalls.workaround: declare about 2 GB per rank; 8 ranks need 16 GB

pitfalls.symptom: the solver keeps ngrid_r = 60000 for every frequency (the per-band grid scaling in dsmti.f is commented out) and only lmax scales by band, so cost is 20 to 65 s per frequency per rank whatever the frequency; the angular-order cutoff the convergence test picks is a multiple of 500 (1000 for most decks, 1500, 2000, 3000 for the shallow-source PKIKP and slab decks)
pitfalls.workaround: the frequency count is the only cheap knob; choose it per deck for the 300 s line

pitfalls.symptom: step6 dies with 'src_window: unbound variable' when steps 4 and 5 have not run (their metadata .env files are missing), whatever the Par_file says; and PKP660PKP's Par_file stage lengths (3000 + 3000) exceed its TIME_LENGTH_DSM_1D (4000), which step6 rejects
pitfalls.workaround: one-line metadata files TIME_SERIES_LENGTH=... under WORK/DSM/{src_to_box,box_to_recv}/DATA, sized so the sum stays under the 1-D window

pitfalls.symptom: prepare_src_to_box.py and prepare_box_to_recv.py require WORK/SPECFEM3D/DATA/dsm_model_input from step 1 and exit without it (step6 falls back to dsm_model_base)
pitfalls.workaround: copy the scenario's shipped 1D_DSM/DATA/dsm_model_input (the step-1 product) there

pitfalls.symptom: JGR_Wu2026 run.sh drivers cd into a tensor directory and then use relative paths written for the directory above: dsmti and dsm_model_input are not found
pitfalls.workaround: assemble the deck from the tables the script writes, the model it names and its awk edit
